name: Navalmoral (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over blue in the proportions 3:1, the white charged with three red Greek crosses in a row.
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 3 May 2002 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 99 of 24 May 2002); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of two horizontal stripes of 3/4 and 1/4, the upper white with three red Greek crosses in line and the lower blue.

features.role: three Greek crosses in a row
